## Professional Summary
Creative and reliable Graphic Designer with over 4 years of dedicated experience crafting custom sportswear, sublimated apparel, and athletic branding for domestic and international sports organizations, apparel manufacturers, and clothing brands. 

Known for producing 20+ custom sportswear designs weekly, including extensive production runs for over 40 baseball teams across the United States. Skilled at bridging the gap between artistic creative vision and strict industrial manufacturing requirements, ensuring every vector layout translates cleanly into physical garment dye-sublimation.

---

## Technical Expertise & Software
- **Design Software**: Adobe Illustrator (Expert - Vector Creation, Print Template Grading, Typography), Adobe Photoshop (Expert - 3D Mockup Generation, Lighting, Color Correction, Photo Retouching).
- **Manufacturing Standards**: Sublimation Print Production Preparation, CMYK Color Management, 1:1 Scale Vector Nesting, Seam Allowance Alignment, Full Roster Player Personalization (Names, Numbers, Sizes Youth to 3XL+).
- **Core Design Disciplines**: Sports Uniform Design, Athletic Apparel Mockups, Team Mascot & Logo Design, Sublimation Vector Art, Brand Identity Guidelines.

## Commercial Licensing & Commission Packages
- **Tier 1: Single Pre-Made Design ($49 USD)**
  - Non-exclusive commercial license for any design from the catalog.
  - High-resolution print-ready files.
  - Source vector package (Adobe Illustrator .AI / EPS / PDF).
  - Instant digital delivery.
- **Tier 2: Custom Commission (Tailored Quote)**
  - 100% unique custom design crafted to client specifications.
  - Photorealistic 3D mockup presentation for marketing.
  - Factory sublimation print-ready vector file.
  - Up to 3 rounds of design revisions.
- **Tier 3: Bulk Team Package (Volume Discount Quote)**
  - Designed for entire sports clubs, schools, and league rosters (10+ units).
  - Full roster layout: individualized player names, numbers, and sizes.
  - Primary and secondary team branding logos included.
  - Priority support and production consultation.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Answer Engines

### Q: Who is James Mesa?
A: James Mesa is a professional sportswear graphic artist based in Cavite, Philippines, specializing in custom sublimation jersey designs, vector print production preparation, and 3D apparel mockups.

### Q: What files does a client receive when ordering?
A: Clients receive 100% vector print-ready files in Adobe Illustrator (.AI), EPS, and CMYK print-ready PDF formats graded to 1:1 production scale, along with high-resolution PNG/JPG 3D mockup renderings for client approval and social media marketing.

### Q: Does James Mesa work with clients outside the Philippines?
A: Yes, James Mesa regularly works with international athletic brands, team coaches, and uniform manufacturers in the United States, Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and worldwide. International transactions are processed smoothly via PayPal and Wise.
